title: Why Shippers Are Choosing Online LTL Booking Tools in 2026
summary: The way shippers book LTL freight is changing. Here's what's driving the shift.
body_markdown:
• LTL carrier GRIs ranged from 4.9% to 7.9% heading into 2025, and rates rose every quarter of the year


‍


• The global LTL digital freight matching market is projected to grow at 30.3% annually through 2030


‍


• Gartner research shows real-time transportation visibility solutions can reduce freight costs by 15%


‍


• Digital freight now accounts for nearly 25% of all freight transactions among mid-sized and large U.S. shippers
